name: excalidraw-studio
description: Create, validate, render, and visually refine repo-local Excalidraw diagrams without Excalidraw+ or cloud storage.

interface.longDescription: Build editable .excalidraw files inside the active Git repository, validate geometry and bindings, render local SVG/PNG previews, and iterate visually without uploads, share links, API keys, or Excalidraw+.
defaultPrompt: Create an Excalidraw architecture diagram and save it in this repo.
Review and improve an existing repo-local .excalidraw file.
Render and inspect this Excalidraw diagram for layout defects.
